changes: New: DATAMATIC, data read as rhythm on a MIDI track (MIDI NOTE SETUP's generator list).
Nine streams (pi, e, phi, the square root of two, the Fibonacci word, the primes, Thue-Morse, a cellular automaton, an LFSR) read through a sliding bit window.
Octave, fifth, tritone, whole-tone or semitone jumps; velocity and micro-timing from the data; YES reads the next byte.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
